source_analysis.skill: Identify the unique listed elementary row operation that makes a specified matrix entry zero.
reasoning_steps: Evaluate candidate operations using the target-column entries.
Select the unique successful operation and verify its whole-row effect.

One elementary operation with exactly one successful listed choice.
Prompt, key, and worked matrix transformation agree.
permitted_variations: Target coordinates, donor rows, signed entries, and simple fractional multipliers.
Coherent row/column permutations and option ordering.
Non-target-column changes that preserve the correct operation.

decision_variation.details: Relevant changes switched correctness; irrelevant changes preserved it. Conditional probes covered every sampled bank. Delivery retained 5/5 batch and 98/98 independent records; no tested cue solved the entire batch. Missing q-72858 prevents complete decision coverage. Selection conclusions use captured inventory and explicit policy/history assumptions.
